entities.summary: Paul Marie Verlaine was a French poet, writer and critic associated with the Symbolist, Parnassianist and Decadent movements. He is considered one of the paramount exponents of the fin de siècle in French and international poetry. Paul Verlaine was a poets & playwrights from Metz (1844-03-30, Metz–1896-01-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
